name: adv_domain_signal_vs_heat_rejected
source:
// A signal port (sig) connected to a heat port (T, Qdot) must fail.
SigConstant   K1(s1, k = 5)
ThermalSource HOT(T = 400)
connect(K1.out, HOT.port)
t = HOT.port.T

error.message: connect(k1.out, hot.port): cannot connect a signal port (k1.out) to a heat port (hot.port) — different physical domains. Couple domains through a transducer component (a motor, pump, heating resistor, …), not a direct connect.
